name: Diagnostic correlation
description: Execute a real Cloud Agent operation through the staging website, then retrieve the backend records for that EXACT operation via the authorized diagnostic adapter and correlate by shared run/request identifiers. Temporal proximity alone is reported as a limitation, never as correlation.

steps.goal: From FreeInference staging, open the Agents application

intervention.requiredAction: Complete Agents authentication in the attached browser tab.

steps.goal: Execute one test-owned Cloud Agent operation and capture its run identifier from the application UI
